response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each row of Invoice_Line_Items is one line item, so line items are counted with COUNT(*) per invoice_number. The table has no declared primary key, so duplicate rows would be counted separately.
Invoices with no line items are excluded because grouping runs only over existing Invoice_Line_Items rows, so no join to Invoices is needed.
Rows where derived_product_cost is NULL or zero produce a NULL ratio and are skipped by AVG, so the average covers only the usable line items of each invoice.
Invoices tied on line-item count are ordered by invoice_number ascending. The request does not specify a tie-breaker, so the top 10 cutoff among tied invoices is arbitrary without it.
